Title: HTC-28054: CAN - ESD protection
Purpose: Check if the CAN signals of the DAA have protection and supports electrostatic discharges.

Inputs.1: 10 positive and negative ESD pulses of 15000 Volts at each CAN signal

1.Expected: Good functionality of the CAN transceivers after the application of the pulses.

pass criteria.error: PASS if the checks in the CAN test are correct after the application of the pulses, otherwise FAIL
